st: Why must the humanities and science start talking again?

sec.p: Ever since secondary school, I've been fascinated by the intersection of the humanities and scientific knowledge. I think you've noticed from futuro fortissimo too (🖼️ ff.18.3 Art, between artificial intelligence and humans, 📜 ff.101.4 Poetic Web).

sec.t: ff.127.4 And what does Palantir have to do with it?
